name: Big Slesh
bio:
Big Slesh, born Solomon Eshegbe, is a Nigerian singer, songwriter and performer from Warri, Delta State, whose music explores the themes of love, emotion and human connection. Deeply rooted in family and shaped by a Christian upbringing, Big Slesh's artistic identity reflects his appreciation for love, meaningful connections and authentic self-expression. A self-described lover boy at heart, he draws inspiration from his personality and experiences, translating them into songs that celebrate romance, affection, confidence and the different dimensions of human relationships.

His journey in music began in 2019, initially exploring sound production and developing his understanding of music from behind the scenes. This foundation gave him an appreciation for musical composition and creative production. In August 2024, he transitioned from producing beats to pursuing a career as a recording artist, marking the beginning of a new chapter dedicated to developing his unique sound and artistic identity.

His debut single, "Love Word," released in August 2024, marked an important milestone in his career. The record gained significant traction, accumulating over three million plays and securing playlist placement on Worldwide Vibes, Afro, Dancehall & More. This achievement established an early connection with listeners and demonstrated the growing reach of his music. He followed this with "Anaconda" in October 2025, which earned playlist placement on Department of Afro Grooves and charted at number 196 on Afrobeats: Cape Verde. In August 2026, he released "True Love," a collaboration with Arosino and Soundsfromwest, exploring the connection and affection shared between two people

With a growing catalogue, expanding audience and a clear creative direction, he remains focused on developing his craft and taking his music to wider audiences across Africa and beyond.
